newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.

text.p: Indonesia's rupiah was little changed against the dollar in late trading on Monday amid ample rupiah liquidity and a further rise in the central bank's fixing rate, dealers said.

"There is not much happening in the market today. The rupiah remained little changed despite the fact that the market has become more liquid in late trading," a dealer from a large privately-owned local bank said.
The dealer said the local currency remained little changed after the raising of the fixing rate as it had been expected.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention band by one point to 2,353/2,545 rupiah and the conversion band to 2,353/2,401 late on Monday.
Another foreign dealer said some overseas rupiah selling was noted after the lunch break, possibly due to profit-taking or dealers taking a covering position ahead of the year-end.
Spot rupiah was last quoted at 2,353.30/53.50 against an opening of 2,353.50/54.00.
He said tom/next was also little changed, despite weekly tax-payments on Tuesday, as liquidity was expected to remain adequate tommorow.
The local bank dealer said the spot rupiah rate was likely to range between 2,353.00 and 2,354.00 on Tuesday.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were last quoted at 2,352.90/53.00 and 2,352.10/52.35, respectively.
Overnight swap was last at 0.45/0.55, tom/next was at 0.42/0.50.
One-month swap was at 16.00/16.50, two at 28.75/31.00, three at 41.50/42.50 and six at 85.75/86.50 points.
